lines.t: I've watched you carry all that weight
Through restless nights and hurried days
Your hands are tied, your heart is worn
You keep on running, toward the storm
But in the quiet, I hear your voice
Calling me to make a choice to bring you home
So come away from all the noise
Lay down the fear inside your voice
The world can wait just for tonight
Let heaven hold you in the light
Come and rest beneath the sky
Let the spinning world pass by
Lay your labor, lay it down
Leave your sorrow on the ground
This day is holy
Set apart a quiet fire inside your heart
Come and rest, come and see
There is peace
Peace in him
You thought the Sabbath was a rule
A line to keep, a way to pull
But he was calling through the years
Beyond the noise, beyond your fears
For more than slain, more than still
Is learning how to trust his will and dwell with it
Come and rest beneath this sky
Let the spinning world pass by
Lay your labor, lay it down
Leave your sorrow on the ground
Now this day is only set apart, a quiet fire inside your heart
Come and rest, come and see, there is peace in heaven
He made the dawn, he named the stars
He seized the wounds beneath your scars
He blessed the day, he made it slow
So tired hearts could come to know
All the God who rested when work was done
Still calls you close, his weary one
So take his hand, don't be afraid
His love has made a holy place
Come and rest beneath his sky
Let the spinning world pass by
Lay your labor, lay it down
Leave your sorrow on the ground
This day is holy
Set apart a quiet fire inside your heart
Come and rest, come and see
There is peace in him
Follow him step by step
Let your heart catch its breath
Sabbath, Sabbath
Rest in them
